_comment: d=3 HPC2 markers, used with the PRODUCER-ANCHORED gadget (pini_hpc3.c MARKV). Feed to your ORIGINAL ooolyzer_iew.py. Ids decimal: z12=18 z13=19 z21=33 z23=35 z31=49 z32=50 f1=241 f2=242 f3=243.
